turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Good afternoon, Ms. Iyer. Thanks for meeting me at the plant.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: No problem. We have been having trouble with our current hydraulic pumps.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: What kind of trouble are you seeing?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Two breakdowns this month. Each one stopped the line for six hours.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Our Apex Hydra three hundred series comes with a two year warranty and service within twenty four hours.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Kirloskar quoted us one lakh eighty thousand per pump. What is your price?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Our price is two lakh ten thousand, but that includes installation and annual maintenance.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: That is thirty thousand more. I will need approval from our plant head, Mr. Nair.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Understood. Shall I send a cost comparison over five years so Mr. Nair can see the savings?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Yes, please send it by Wednesday. Our budget meeting is on the fifteenth.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I will send it by Wednesday morning, and I can join the budget meeting if that helps.
